name: Airport Police Contraband Simulator - Border Patrol
description:
Airport Contraband Police puts you on the front lines against illegal smuggling at an international airport. As a police officer, you ensure security and prevent contraband from crossing borders.

Missions and Challenges: Uncover illegal schemes through covert searches, passenger interrogations, and luggage checks. Solve puzzles to find hidden items. Each mission grows more difficult, requiring sharp observation and professionalism.

Diverse Equipment: Use advanced tools like X-ray scanners, night vision cameras, metal detectors, and police dogs to detect contraband and protect the airport.

Character Development: Level up to unlock new skills and gear, becoming an expert in contraband detection. Achievements grant bonuses and unlock tougher missions.

A Variety of Contraband Goods: Find drugs, weapons, smuggled animals, counterfeit documents, and more hidden in luggage compartments, clothing, containers, or even inside live couriers.

Difficulty and Dynamics: From simple inspections to complex operations, the game challenges you with timed missions demanding quick decisions and action.

Prepare yourself for an intense and immersive experience where every detail matters in keeping the airport safe.
